mapper.insert: INSERT into account(account_id, user_id, account_name, account_type, owner_id, balance, account_foreign, is_deleted) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{userId}, #{accountName}, #{accountType}, #{ownerId}, #{balance}, #{accountForeign}, #{isDeleted})
INSERT into account_member(account_id, user_id, role, main_account_id) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{mainAccountId})
